subject: Re: Demo for OceanGuard — scheduling conflict due to client site travel
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@oceanguard.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo for OceanGuard — proposed on-site week of Jun 23

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, we set aside 60 minutes for an on-site demo focused on low-latency inference and deployment patterns. Proposed window: Tuesday, Jun 23 at 10:00am PDT (we can shift to 11am if that helps).

Agenda (draft) attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf — quick architecture walkthrough, live modulated demo, Q&A and next steps.

If that slot works, I’ll lock the calendar and include a short pre-read for your security team. If not, let me know alternatives — we can also convert this into a recorded walkthrough plus a 30-minute live office-hours session if travel timing is tight.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

[redwood-demo-agenda.pdf attached]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@oceanguard.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucas Ortega <lucas.ortega@oceanguard.com>, procurement@oceanguard.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo for OceanGuard — proposed on-site week of Jun 23

Jordan —

Appreciate the follow-up. Quick heads-up: our clinical ops team unexpectedly moved a block of site visits into the week of Jun 22–26. I’ll be traveling with that team and will be offline/onsite most of the week (travel between sites and airports).

Two options from our side:
1) Move the demo earlier (Mon Jun 22 before 11am PDT) — I may still be in transit but could swing a short window.
2) Convert to an asynchronous recorded walkthrough + schedule a 30-min live office-hours session (we'd join remotely) the week after (w/c Jun 29).
3) Or have Lucas (copied) attend the on-site session in my stead if you prefer to keep something live that week.

Also looping procurement — I’ll have them send over the vendor questionnaire; attaching here the template so you can see required fields.

Apologies for the churn. Travel popped up late. Let me know which approach you prefer and we’ll confirm.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Clinical Operations
OceanGuard Therapeutics

[oceanguard-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx attached]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@oceanguard.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Lucas Ortega <lucas.ortega@oceanguard.com>, procurement@oceanguard.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo for OceanGuard — proposed on-site week of Jun 23

Marta — thanks for the quick note and for looping Lucas/procurement. Totally understand — travel windows can be brutal. Quick options from our side: 

A) We can record a focused 20–25 minute walkthrough of the same demo flows (low-latency calls, routing policies, simple integration sample). We’ll send the recording within 48 hours and include a short handbook for your infra/security folks. Then schedule a 30-minute live office-hours session (strict Q&A) the week of Jun 29; I can run the office-hours or hand it to Connor (cc’d) who can deep-dive infra.

B) Keep a live session on Jun 23 and have Connor cover it live if Lucas is available to take the lead on your side. Connor has run the exact lab environment demos before.

C) If you can do Mon Jun 22 before 11am PDT, we’ll prioritize that and deliver the live agenda as planned.

I attached a short recording preview file (demo-recording-preview.mp4) and the final agenda PDF — these are drafts but show the level of detail we’ll capture.

Which do you prefer? If you pick the asynchronous + office-hours route, I’ll: 1) record/send the walkthrough within 48 hours, 2) send a Calendly link for the office-hours (suggested times: Jun 29 09:00–11:00 PDT or Jun 30 13:00–15:00 PDT), and 3) share the security pre-read.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

[demo-recording-preview.mp4 attached]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@oceanguard.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucas Ortega <lucas.ortega@oceanguard.com>, procurement@oceanguard.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo for OceanGuard — proposed on-site week of Jun 23

Jordan —

Thanks — option A sounds best for our schedule. Please go ahead with the recording; our preference is to watch asynchronously and then join a focused 30-minute office-hours session on Tue Jun 30 at 13:30 PDT. Lucas will coordinate any follow-up logistics on our side. Procurement will review the vendor questionnaire and reach out if they need anything else.

A few asks for the recording: please include a short section on data retention models and the Dedicated capacity SLA (we'll want that for procurement). Also, call out any recommended quantization/latency settings for single-region US deployments.

Once you send the recording, we’ll distribute internally and lock the office-hours.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Clinical Operations
OceanGuard Therapeutics

--
Jordan Blake
Replying on behalf: Jordan confirmed plan and created a Calendly slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-demo-30m

[Action] Jordan to: 1) Record 20–25m demo and attachments (agenda + pre-read), 2) Upload recording, 3) Send calendar invite for Tue Jun 30 13:30 PDT office-hours, 4) Share SLA/retention notes for procurement.
